name: UltraTech Cement Ltd
description: UltraTech Cement Ltd is the flagship cement company of the Aditya Birla Group and India's largest cement and ready-mix concrete (RMC) manufacturer, ranking as the third largest cement producer in the world outside of China. revenue_breakup.desc: Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC), Portland Pozzolana Cement (PPC), and bulk construction cement.
Birla White brand white cement, wall putty, primers, and texture plasters.

moats_and_strengths: Insurmountable scale moat with 154+ MTPA capacity, commanding over 22% of India's cement market.
Pan-India manufacturing presence with clinker and grinding units positioned within 300 km of major consumption centers.
Direct distribution reach with over 100,000 retail channel partners across every district in India.
Low-cost manufacturing leader supported by 320+ MW of Waste Heat Recovery Systems (WHRS) and alternate fuels.
company_profile.order_book_or_capacity: Installed Cement Capacity: 154+ MTPA • Capex Pipeline targeting 200 MTPA by FY27 • 24 Integrated Plants

bullish_triggers: Acquisition and integration of Kesoram Cement and stake in India Cements expanding southern market reach.

Rising share of premium blended cements boosting realizations per ton.
bearish_risks: Sharp spikes in international petcoke and thermal coal prices inflating kiln energy costs.
Price competition and capacity additions in the northern and central Indian cement clusters.
